name: Windows TCP Timestamping Disabled
description:
Ensures TCP timestamps are disabled (Tcp1323Opts = 0), reducing exposure to timestamp-based fingerprinting and uptime disclosure. Note that this value also disables TCP window scaling; review throughput impact before enforcing.
Required Windows permission: LEA agent account must be allowed to run only: reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters /v Tcp1323Opts.
